prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Samarium (사마륨) itself — the sovereign of the Samarium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: samarium: a hard silvery metal that slowly yellows in air, found in 1879 in samarskite, a velvety black ore from the Ilmen hills of the Urals that had been named for the Russian mining officer who let scientists study it, which makes samarium the first element named, through its mineral, after a person; alloyed with cobalt it makes magnets that keep their pull where others let go in the heat, driving motors in spacecraft and aircraft, and one of its isotopes eases the pain of cancer in bone. Palette: velvet samarskite black, deep cobalt blue, pale topaz yellow, steady heat-glow orange.

World (fixed): year 2200, a base on the surface of Venus under a heavy orange sky, hot enough to melt lead: heat-shielded domes where samarium-cobalt motors that never lose their grip in the heat are serviced, a thick heat-shield gate, dense yellow clouds and a dim smudge of sun overhead. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) heavy assault bulk — big, thick shoulder and leg armor, a broad upper silhouette and large thrusters on the back and legs, while the torso stays fitted and the waist narrow; 2) large wing-shaped binder plates spread symmetrically behind her back as the main shape, with light body armor; 3) several rigid jointed armor plates flaring from the waist like a skirt — plates, not cloth — with the legs showing between them; 4) a long coat made of rigid plates from the shoulders to below the knees, open at the front to show the body armor, with an angular collar; 5) a large ring halo behind her head and a tall crown-like head unit, with long hanging shoulder plates — a ceremonial, elegant shape; 6) complete full-body armor with plates joined seamlessly from neck to feet — bare skin only on the face and where EXPOSURE allows, dense visible seams and joints; 7) a slender torso with oversized mechanical forearms and lower legs — huge gauntlets and boots — the contrast is the main shape; 8) mecha armor shaped like a medieval knight's plate — big rounded pauldrons, a breastplate, layered plates below the waist, a head ornament instead of a helmet so her face shows; 9) several long rigid jointed plates hanging from behind the shoulders to the ankles like a cape — plates, not cloth. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): velvet samarskite black, deep cobalt blue, pale topaz yellow, steady heat-glow orange.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): velvety black hair with pale topaz-yellow glints like warmed metal. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Mecha (fixed): she is a female mecha personification — her whole body is covered in solid hard-surface mecha armour plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines, never cloth or a gown; no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates — any cape, skirt or wing is rigid armoured plates. Her face and hair stay human.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Sm) and atomic number (62) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

Resolved original design 2: Choose silhouette 4, a long rigid armored coat from shoulders below knees, open at front over fitted full-body mecha armor, angular collar; no fabric. Signature: the armored coat is built from interlocking black-silver magnetic yoke plates, with cobalt motor rings at hips and ceramic topaz thermal spacers; steady orange glow within narrow joints. Deep neckline armor opening and small bare upper-arm gaps, intimate areas covered. Human ordinary empty hands with five fingers. Velvet black topaz-glinted hair in an asymmetric short pixie with long swept fringe. Adult diamond-soft face, honey-tan skin, pale ice-blue eyes, a firm reserved expression. Front-facing walking stance with one boot slightly forward, arms relaxed away from coat. Before a colossal heat-shield gate on Venus, dense orange sky, domes visible through haze. Face-level portrait perspective, entire head and both armored boots in frame.

observations: 1024x1536; one adult woman; full body and both ordinary empty hands visible; paired limbs connected.
